title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: An attacker can bypass authentication and potentially gain administrator access without knowing the password.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or an ORM so user input is never concatenated into SQL statements.

title: UNION-based SQL Injection in Product Search
payload_used: qwert')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
impact: An attacker can retrieve unauthorized user records, including email addresses and password hashes, through the product search endpoint.
remediation: Use parameterized queries for search operations and apply least-privilege database permissions.

title: Reflected XSS in Search
impact: An attacker can execute JavaScript in a victim's browser through a specially crafted search URL.
remediation: Contextually encode output, avoid inserting user input into innerHTML, and implement a strict Content Security Policy.

title: Stored XSS via Customer Feedback
impact: An attacker can store a malicious payload through customer feedback that executes when the affected content is rendered.
remediation: Sanitize and encode stored input before rendering it, use a trusted HTML sanitizer, and implement a Content Security Policy.
